selected.heading: Selected Projects
selected.sub: How I define the problem, what I decided, and what changed — shown through three projects.

items.d: 53% in surveys, 562 repos, a 40%p usage gap — every plan starts from a verifiable number.
A 100-point rubric, graded violation verdicts, a 5-photo rule — I design rules where interests collide.
A submission checker, a finals console, an FAQ bot — when a tool doesn't exist, I build it and ship it.

about.heading: About
about.description_1: PM of CleanB (3-person team) — owning planning, design, and releases while building the cleaner-side frontend myself. Before that, as a Community Manager Intern at LIKELION, I ran a community of ~2,500 members across 80 universities and the national hackathon.
about.description_2: Double major in Global Business & Technology and AI Convergence. Through LIKELION staff roles, hackathons, and startup programs I've planned and built 15 services, 11 of which won awards. I built my backend and QA foundations by completing SSAFY's 15th Java track.
about.description_3: Products people actually use, decisions backed by data, and teams that grow together — my goal is to be a PM who delivers all three at once.
